observations.footwork: Widening stance, left foot steps forward and plants firmly.
observations.guard: Right focus mitt raised high, left focus mitt held lower near chest.
observations.upper_body: Torso rotates slightly, leaning into the widening stance.
observations.notable: Dynamic weight shifting with the left leg extending outward.

observations.footwork: Steps back, narrows stance, then steps out wide again.
observations.guard: Right mitt raised, left mitt stays lower, bobbing with movement.
observations.upper_body: Rotates back and forth as the feet adjust.
observations.distance: Opens and closes slightly during the step sequence.
observations.notable: Brief pause and regroup in the middle, then re-engages with a step-out.

observations.footwork: Drops weight, slides, and extends into a wide stance.
observations.upper_body: Crouching and shifting weight forward and backward.
observations.notable: End of sequence, returns to initial position.

movement_events.detail: Left foot steps forward, widening the stance.
Steps back, narrowing the stance and opening distance slightly.
Steps in and widens stance, closing distance again.
Drops weight and adjusts feet into a lower, wider position.
Returns to the starting posture and guard position.
